attrs.evidence: docs/spec/proof-wire/experiment/run_state.mjs + holdout_runner.mjs measure(); governance/holdout_score.mjs is 60 lines and names a path; governance/blind_run.mjs --complete spawns the frozen runner and compares its authority block field by field against what it recomputed. Falsifier J: a wrapper asserting REVEALED opens nothing. Falsifier N: a candidate that only exits 99 cannot COMPLETE. Gate `gov-nest`; grid booleans run-state-frozen, status-witnessed, secret-path-self-authenticating, score-gate-delegates.
attrs.statement: NO UNFROZEN PROGRAM MAY DECIDE WHETHER SECRET BYTES ARE RELEASED, OR WHETHER THE EXPERIMENT COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY. P4.7 put the reveal gate in the caller and a candidate frozen but unrevealed received all ten hidden constructions. P4.7.1 moved the gate INTO the frozen runner -- and then handed it, from mutable governance/holdout_score.mjs, the very fact it gates on: `--status <string>`. Changing that one argument to the literal REVEALED gave a CANDIDATE_FROZEN candidate H1 through H10 with --reveal never called, while SPEC-RELEASE, BLIND-RUN and HOLDOUT-SCORE all printed PASS. A frozen decision function over an untrusted claim is not an authenticated boundary; it is the same function with the trust moved one argument to the left. THE SAME SHAPE ONE LAYER UP: --complete spawned the same mutable caller for the summary it then wrote into a RESULT receipt, so a candidate whose entire body was `exit 99` reached COMPLETE claiming 25/25 and interoperability agreement. The scorer, the runner, the state machine, the run identity, the transition preconditions and the receipt-chain rule all live inside experiment/, therefore inside experiment_digest, therefore inside spec_release_id. WHAT IS LEFT OUTSIDE IS ONE DIRECTORY PATH, AND EVEN THAT IS NOT TRUSTED: the frozen instrument re-digests whatever directory it is handed and requires it to equal the release's holdout_commitment, so a wrapper cannot lie about where the secret is. The transition and the measurement now share ONE definition of a valid run, which is why a binary could no longer be refused at spawn and revealed to anyway.
